propositions: Backfill close_class for closed bugs lacking it using only structural signals: reverts of STATUS/COMMITS events, plan-review BLOCK verdicts, or gate_error_v1 ERROR records.
A bug with a revert whose target_event_type is STATUS or COMMITS maps to regression; only substantive reverts (not COMMENT/LINK reverts) qualify.

A bug with a plan-review BLOCK verdict (verdict==BLOCK from REVIEW_RESULT events) maps to plan_defect; bugs with gate_error_v1 records on REVIEW_RESULT or COMPLETION_VERDICT streams map to env_integration.
Backfilled records are written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, segregated from authoritative close_class values.
The backfill is idempotent: bugs already present in the artifact or already carrying state[close_class] are skipped; --dry-run prints without writing.
Bugs with no matching structural signal default to undetermined; all non-authoritative backfilled records have is_authoritative(source) return False.
